item.title: Delhi Court Convicts Asiya Andrabi in UAPA Case, Quantum of Sentence on Jan 17
item.description: New Delhi: A Delhi court on Wednesday convicted Kashmiri separatist and Dukhtaran-e-Millat chief Asiya Andrabi in a UAPA case. Additional Sessions Judge Chanderjit Singh ordered their conviction under sections 18 (Punishment for conspiracy) and 38 (Offence relating to membership of a terrorist organisation) of UAPA.
